mapper.update: UPDATE exam_material SET content = #{content}, title = #{title} WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT id, paper_id, section, title, content, sort_order FROM exam_material WHERE id = #{materialId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO exam_question (paper_id, material_id, section, qno, qorder, stem, options, answer, analysis, has_image, create_time) VALUES (#{paperId}, #{materialId}, #{section}, #{qno}, #{qorder}, #{stem}, #{options}, #{answer}, #{analysis}, #{hasImage}, NOW())
mapper.select: SELECT IFNULL(MAX(qorder), 0) FROM exam_question WHERE paper_id = #{paperId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO exam_material (paper_id, section, title, content, sort_order) VALUES (#{paperId}, #{section}, #{title}, #{content}, 9999)
INSERT INTO exam_paper (paper_code, title, year, version, subject, question_count, create_time) VALUES (#{paperCode}, #{title}, #{year}, #{version}, #{subject}, 0, NOW())

INSERT INTO exam_record (user_id, question_id, user_answer, is_correct, answered_time) VALUES (#{userId}, #{questionId}, #{userAnswer}, #{isCorrect}, NOW()) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE user_answer = VALUES(user_answer), is_correct = VALUES(is_correct), answered_time = NOW()
mapper.select: SELECT id, user_id, question_id, user_answer, is_correct, answered_time FROM exam_record WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND question_id = #{questionId}

SELECT q.id AS questionId, q.paper_id AS paperId, q.section AS section, q.qorder AS qorder, q.qno AS qno, q.stem AS stem, q.options AS options, q.answer AS answer, q.analysis AS analysis, q.material_id AS materialId, q.has_image AS hasImage, m.content AS materialContent, m.title AS materialTitle, r.user_answer AS userAnswer, r.answered_time AS answeredTime, p.title AS paperTitle, p.year AS year, p.version AS version FROM exam_record r JOIN exam_question q ON q.id = r.question_id JOIN exam_paper p ON p.id = q.paper_id LEFT JOIN exam_material m ON m.id = q.material_id WHERE r.user_id = #{userId} AND r.is_correct = 0 ORDER BY r.answered_time DESC

SELECT r.question_id AS questionId, r.user_answer AS userAnswer, r.is_correct AS isCorrect FROM exam_record r JOIN exam_question q ON q.id = r.question_id WHERE r.user_id = #{userId} AND q.paper_id = #{paperId}
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM exam_record WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND question_id = #{questionId}
DELETE FROM exam_record WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND is_correct = 0
mapper.select: SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM exam_question WHERE paper_id = #{paperId}) AS total, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM exam_record r JOIN exam_question q ON q.id = r.question_id WHERE r.user_id = #{userId} AND q.paper_id = #{paperId}) AS answered, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM exam_record r JOIN exam_question q ON q.id = r.question_id WHERE r.user_id = #{userId} AND q.paper_id = #{paperId} AND r.is_correct = 1) AS correct

SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM exam_paper) AS papers, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM exam_question) AS questions, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM exam_material) AS materials, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM exam_record WHERE user_id = #{userId}) AS answered, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM exam_record WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND is_correct = 1) AS correct, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM exam_record WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND is_correct = 0) AS wrong

SELECT q.section AS section, COUNT(*) AS total, SUM(CASE WHEN r.is_correct = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS correct FROM exam_record r JOIN exam_question q ON q.id = r.question_id WHERE r.user_id = #{userId} GROUP BY q.section ORDER BY total DESC
